title: List a report's follow-up checks
description: Every follow-up check on one report, newest first, with its kind, status, next run and last verdict. Pass the `report_id` of the report to read; no `run_id` is needed. Read this before writing a check: a report already carrying one for the same claim needs no second, and a report holds at most five open checks at a time. A `pending` check is waiting for the report to resolve before its clock starts; every status other than `pending` and `active` is terminal. `run_state` says where an open check is: `waiting_on_report`, `paused`, `scheduled`, `due`, `queued`, `running`, or `stale`. For an `agent` check, `waiting_on_run`, `dispatched_run_id`, and `dispatched_at` name the run the coordinator dispatched and when.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: Where the check is in its run cycle. `waiting_on_report`: pending, no fix to measure yet. `paused`: active, but its report is suppressed or its horizon passed, so nothing runs it. `scheduled`: active, not due yet. `due`: due now, so a run on the check's scout may record the verdict. `queued`: a run was dispatched and has not started. `running`: the dispatched run started and has time left. `stale`: the dispatched run recorded nothing in its window, so the coordinator dispatches again. Any other value is the terminal status.
